description: Is this address worth sending to? Syntax check, then the domain's mail route via DNS-over-HTTPS: domain exists, MX hosts (or A fallback), null MX (domain refuses mail), SPF and DMARC presence, role account (info@, support@…) and plus-tag flags, and a verdict. It does not contact the mail server, so it cannot confirm that the mailbox itself exists. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/email-check.
name: email_check
title: Email address check (syntax + domain mail route)
